Operations: Transport the robot to the intended mounting location.
Lift and secure the robot to the platform or foundation.
Secure the tools on the end of the robot, if any.
Take out the control cabinet from the packaging materials and carry it to the vicinity of the robot.
References: See :ref:`Mounting the Control Cabinet <Control cabinet installation>`

Operations: Connect the robot connection cable, control cabinet power cord, control stick cable, Ethernet cable (if any), and TIO cable (if any) in sequence.
References:
| Refer to  
|  :ref:`Robot Connection Cable Interface <Robot-Connection-Cable-Interface>`
|  :ref:`Bottom Panel Interfaces <Bottom-Panel-Interfaces>` 
|  :ref:`Tool I/O Port <Tool I/O Port>`

Operations: Flip the toggle switch at the bottom of the control cabinet to turn on the power switch.
The emergency stop button on control stick is released by default, if it is pressed, please release it first.
Power up the control cabinet, power on and enable the robot with the control stick.
References: See :ref:`Power On and Shut Down the Robot System <Power On and Shut Down the Robot System>`

Operations: Connect the robot using a computer or pad or mobile phone.
When the control cabinet is powered by a supply other than 220 V, you must configure the control cabinet power supply to "Other" in the JAKA App immediately after connecting the robot.
Set the mounting orientation, payloads and collision sensitivity of the robot in the JAKA App.
Press and hold the FREE button on the robot wrist, or move the robot from the manual operation or programming screen in |jaka_app|
References:
| Refer to
|  :ref:`Free and point button <Free-and-Point-Buttons>`
|  |jaka_app| Software User Manual
